tools.description: Build and package the release artifact.
tools.origin_evidence: .github/workflows/build.yml (name: build) checks out inputs.sha, packages services/pay into pay-api.zip, and publishes an immutable Lambda version; web/package.json defines build = 'tsc --noEmit && vite build'.

tools.description: Unit tests. Relevant whenever source code changes.
tools.origin_evidence: build.yml runs 'cd services/pay && python -m pytest tests -q'; services/pay/pyproject.toml sets [tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths=['tests'] and services/pay/tests/test_api.py exists. web/package.json defines test = 'vitest run'.

tools.description: UI acceptance tests. Relevant when the front end changes.
tools.origin_evidence: web/package.json defines test:ui = 'playwright test' and includes @playwright/test in devDependencies. No CI workflow runs it — build.yml does not invoke test:ui.

tools.description: Verify the change was approved by a peer before it was merged. This reviews nothing: the review happens on the pull request, and this confirms it was not skipped.
tools.origin_evidence: Gate on code-review that applies to any service regardless; release-agent.yml releases on push to main and reads GOVERNANCE at the parent commit, so review enforcement is a platform concern. No repository-specific review config was surveyed.
